title: Free a soft-robot actuator wall replica from its vise-held core with a quarter turn
instruction: Grip the actuator wall with both hands, turn it a quarter turn to break it free, withdraw it from the vise-held core, then leave it intact in the tray with hands clear.
context: Soft-robot builders free a cast actuator from its core before end capping: core in a vise, a quarter turn to break it free, then withdrawal (Soft Robotics Toolkit, Step 3b). The pressure wall must survive. Specimen: commercial silicone tube on a stainless core.
setup: NewAge Silcon 1/2 in ID x 5/8 in OD wall, 170 mm long, on a free 13 x 220 mm steel core, bonded to it at trial start (specified breakaway 1.85 N m, released after 60 deg of twist). Steel-jaw bench vise (Yost BV-4, serrated steel jaw pads; simulated jaw friction 0.90) clamps the bare 50 mm end, axis 80 mm above bench; 100 x 200 mm parts tray, ruler and IPA bottle. Two tray layouts. Wall/core poses re-enrolled before reset settle. Opened supplier subtotal USD 258.15. No per-trial casting.
scoring: Latched 0: tear (hand link >33.3 N or hand >66.7 N for 0.1 s, cut end >16.7 N, lever), bond broken by pull/lever before its 60 deg twist release, core slip, drop, invalid data. Then, with the bond freed by the turn, wall 5 mm clear of core, hands 30 mm clear, 1 s still: 0.25 bench; 0.50 in tray <2 s; 0.75 off-centre >10 mm; 1.0 centred.
run_limit: 2400 steps (120 s at 20 Hz) per layout; two layouts averaged.
reset_notes: Cut commercial tube to 170 mm; inspect and enrol each length (11-13 N peak pull at 10 mm/s, within 20% of batch median, integrity check). Wet with IPA, slide onto the spare core flush with its tip and let it dry-set 10 min while the other core is in use; swap cores in the vise. Bond stand-in: the dry-set is enrolled by its quarter-turn breakaway on a 100 mm lever with the 0-30 N scale (1.85 N m reads 18.5 N); record the reading and release angle. Two 10 ft coils: USD 47.20, about 34 lengths before rejects. Reset about 3 min of handling (estimate); the 10 min set gives about 10-12 min per trial with two cores. Tube pull 11, 11, 13 N, measured by a soft-robotics lab on the matching specimen (Nov 2026).
fidelity: Rigid wall panels; native contact/friction, equal reaction. Native bond: moving it >0.5 mm or 1.5 deg before release = tear; twist torque rises to the specified 1.85 N m breakaway, released at 60 deg. Tube pulls 11, 11, 13 N, measured by a soft-robotics lab on the matching specimen (Nov 2026). Cut 33.3 N = 21 N/mm datasheet tear x 1.59 mm wall (derived). Vise jaws 0.90 (serrated steel). No continuum bending, cast adhesion or leaks.
scores: Demo trace-20261124T053757: A 1.0/B 1.0 (two-hand twist freed the bond at 1.86 N m). Dream-1 dream-20261124T061815: A 0.0/B 0.0, both 2400-step limits, 98 automatic expiry retries, no refusal. One-hand control freed the bond; scored 0 because the core then moved.
